ticks.note: The clock is stopped and the display is live.
`startStop` starts the clock. The during action is delayed, so `time` starts counting in the next tick.
`time` counts one per tick; the display follows it in the same tick.
`lap` freezes the display at the current time.
The clock keeps running, the display does not.
A second `lap` makes the display live again: it shows the time at once.
`startStop` stops the clock. `go to` is a weak abort, so the during action still counted this tick.
`clear` sets the stopped clock back to zero.
